brief: Goldman Sachs recommends selling Corridor Variance Swaps on a custom basket of 22 high-beta, AI-adjacent US names, positioning the trade against the desk's own downside volatility buying that arises from Autocall structured-product flow. Rationale: corridor variance swaps are structured to best match the vega supply generated by structured retail products, since realized variance under a corridor swap accrues only while the underlying spot stays within a pre-defined strike range. The structure layers a plain variance swap, a corridor overlay restricting accrual to 70%-120% of initial spot, and a portfolio wrapper across the basket. Terms: maturity 17 September 2027, vega notional USD 1mm, payout cap 2.5x, convention T,T-1, strike offer 53.21. Basket weights range from roughly 1% to 7.19% per name; total weight is 100% with a weighted long strike of 53.21. Maximum loss occurs if every basket stock realizes variance at zero. The note is a trade term sheet built around a single structure, not an argued multi-step thesis.
